title: The Most Important Sales Skills and How to Practice Them
summary: Learn eight sales skills that matter in buyer conversations, with short drills, clear scoring evidence, and a repeatable practice plan.
body_markdown:
Skill


Observable behavior


Buyer pressure


Short drill


Evidence to score


Preparation


States a useful hypothesis and invites correction


Buyer rejects the assumption


Two-minute account prep and 30-second opening


Fact and assumption stay separate; question changes the plan


Agenda setting


Agrees on purpose and desired outcome


Time is cut or buyer goal changes


Reset the first two minutes of the call


Buyer confirms the revised agenda


Discovery depth


Asks about effect, urgency, and decision path


Buyer gives a surface answer


Follow one problem to a business effect


Buyer supplies new consequence or decision detail


Active listening


Changes the next question based on the answer


Buyer reveals a conflicting fact


Hidden-fact branch exercise


Rep names the detail and follows it


Value articulation


Connects an approved capability to buyer evidence


Buyer asks why it matters


Reframe one feature around buyer context


Rep uses buyer language and checks the link


Objection handling


Clarifies before responding


Stated objection hides another concern


Hidden-motive objection card


Rep classifies the concern before giving evidence


Negotiation


Trades within agreed boundaries


Buyer asks for price or term movement


Concession planning round


Rep receives something for each move


Next step


Confirms action, owner, and timing


Buyer stays positive but vague


Close the final two minutes


Buyer accepts a dated action
